# August Advisory

## What We Do
August Advisory is a Malaysian professional services firm specialising in CFO advisory, taxation, SST (Sales and Service Tax), e-Invoice compliance, payroll, and corporate secretarial services. We serve SMEs and entrepreneurs across Malaysia.

## Who We Serve
- Small and medium-sized business owners in Malaysia
- Entrepreneurs and startups navigating Malaysian tax law
- Directors and company owners managing compliance obligations
- Individuals with income tax, rental income, or investment queries

## Services
- CFO Advisory — outsourced financial management and strategic advice
- Taxation — income tax planning, filing, and LHDN compliance
- SST — Sales and Service Tax registration, filing, and advisory
- e-Invoice — implementation guidance and compliance for Malaysia's e-invoicing mandate
- Payroll — payroll processing and EPF/SOCSO/EIS compliance
- Corporate Secretarial — company incorporation, annual returns, SSM filings
- e-Stamping — stamp duty computation and filing

## Blog
Our blog covers practical insights on Malaysian tax law, SST, e-Invoice, LHDN rulings, and business compliance. Articles are written for business owners, not accountants. Topics include:
- Income tax for property owners, directors, and employees
- SST registration thresholds and exemptions
- e-Invoice implementation timelines and requirements
- LHDN audit triggers and how to avoid them
- Director loans and deemed interest under Section 140B
- Women returning to work tax incentives
- Company compliance under the Companies Act 2016
